Shared IPC record/registry fields still compose serialized cross-family transactions.
Untimed admission-pressure retries, cancellation/producer Drop and broader caller/IRQ/guard contexts retain existing qualification boundaries.
Readiness grants no result observation, attachment adoption, replay, physical quiescence or recovery custody.
No broader pressure/fairness, model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
